summary_en: Board resolution to acquire additional 30% stake (60,000 shares) in consolidated subsidiary GBS (Singapore) PTE. LTD. to achieve 100% ownership. Parent company Japan Material to acquire 42,000 shares; subsidiary ALDON TECHNOLOGIES SERVICES PTE LTD to acquire 18,000 shares. Execution scheduled 2026-07-30. Rationale: strengthen group coordination and management foundation in response to business environment changes.
title_en: Notice Regarding Additional Acquisition of Consolidated Subsidiary Shares (Complete Subsidiary Status)
translation_en_brief: Japan Material Co., Ltd. (ticker 6055) announced on 2026-07-23 that its board of directors resolved to acquire an additional 30% stake in consolidated subsidiary GBS (Singapore) PTE. LTD., achieving 100% ownership. The acquisition comprises 60,000 shares: 42,000 to be acquired by Japan Material and 18,000 by subsidiary ALDON TECHNOLOGIES SERVICES PTE LTD. Prior to the transaction, Japan Material and ALDON held 98,000 and 42,000 shares respectively (140,000 total, representing full control already). Post-acquisition, they will hold 140,000 and 60,000 shares respectively (200,000 total). GBS manufactures and sells semiconductor equipment components and automotive vision systems, based in Singapore since 2003. Execution is scheduled for 2026-07-30. The company stated the transaction will have minimal impact on consolidated results for the fiscal period but will provide prompt disclosure if material effects emerge. No acquisition price is disclosed in the filing.
